caption: The drawing features two depictions of a dark brown dog with wavy fur, shown from different angles against a plain, light beige background. Both representations of the dog are outfitted with a silver-gray harness that wraps around their bodies and supports a rectangular, olive-green pack with brown and tan highlights on their backs. The dogs have a similar posture, standing with all four legs on the ground and tails slightly raised, while their heads are held up and facing in different directions—one to the left and the other slightly upward to the right.
